Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Trust Reporting Analyst role on the Collateralized Loan Obligation team in Boston. The job asks for someone who can read a trust indenture, turn it into report specifications and payment calculations, and reconcile periodic collateral data. Reconciliation and control testing are where most of my experience sits.

At Northrop Grumman in Sunnyvale I audited more than 100 financial models for accuracy, compliance and internal controls, and I worked in SAP and Deltek Cobra to keep program cost data clean. That taught me to check a model against its source rules and to document exactly where something does not tie.

Since August 2023 I have been the Financial Manager at AMG Family Dental in Belmont, where I run billing, collections and revenue tracking. I found and recovered more than $500K in annual revenue by improving financial reporting and reconciliation in Dentrix, and I wrote a Python process that reconciles insurance payments weekly. It cut the work from 5 hours to 1 and flags underpaid claims for follow-up.

I hold an M.A. in International Economics and Finance (STEM) from Brandeis and a B.S. in Finance from Suffolk. I am comfortable with Excel, SQL and Python, and I am a U.S. citizen who needs no sponsorship and can work from the Boston office three or more days a week.

I do not yet have structured finance experience, and I would be learning syndicated loans and securitization from the ground up. I would bring accuracy, a habit of finding the root cause of an exception, and the ability to explain results to people who rely on them. I would welcome a conversation about the team.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian
